# Where Does Exactly-Once Live? / LIMBO

Структурированная запись источника. [Карточка](../../studies/exactly-once-limbo.md) · [Первоисточник](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.29095)

## Текущий обзор

[exactly-once-limbo-telegrambot-review](../../reviews/exactly-once-limbo/2026-11-04.md) — BOUNDED_CODE_REVIEW. The review tests pinned TelegramBot control flow with a fake HTTP/service ledger and replays selected original LIMBO contracts. No Telegram, Gemini, YouTube, or Actions network was called; results are synthetic fault scenarios, not production error rates. The 120/180 duplicate fraction is not a real-world frequency. The current Telegram API contract does not document an idempotency key; no production approval.

## Эксперименты

- exactly-once-limbo-telegrambot-bounded-replay: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. Bounded replay of original TelegramBot control flow and send_telegram at pinned commit under fake transport, plus selected original LIMBO World/ToolRuntime fault contracts. Does not validate Telegram API behavior, deployment or production frequency. TelegramBot replay: 120 of 180 synthetic paired-run trajectories duplicated across nine injected fault modes (20 each). Original LIMBO control: no-key x contract duplicated in 60/60 selected fault episodes; stable-key mastodon contract duplicated in 0/60. A separate reservation-only model avoided duplicates but missed 20/20 timeout_pre deliveries; these are bounded test outcomes, not production rates. Fake service ledger is the independent oracle; no real message IDs, provider acknowledgements, or actual Telegram idempotency contract. Sequential synthetic runs; network/IO/process latency not benchmarked. The stable idempotency key result belongs to the illustrative LIMBO mastodon service only. Manual UNCERTAIN policy trades duplicates for potential missing delivery.
